relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure & Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye (uab.gov.tr) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure & Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye (uab.gov.tr).
